title: aggregation.aggregate
description: Aggregate a billable metric over the events of one charges window for one bucket (charge or charge filter), optionally per group (BE-AG-1..27, 30..38, 40..44, 50..56, 73). Store pg (relational) is normative; store ch is the columnar variant (BE-AG-60..69). Numbers are canonical decimal strings; `count` is a decimal because a prorated unique count reports its fractional aggregation as count.

charge_model.description: dynamic: the bucket also totals the events' precise_total_amount_cents (BE-AG-27; sum_agg only).

boundary_transaction_id.description: Price this event in advance: the upper bound becomes its timestamp (ties broken per BE-AG-42) and the pay-in-advance fields are returned.

grouped_by_values.description: Restrict to one group (pay-in-advance of a grouped charge).

is_pay_in_advance.description: The charge is billed in advance.

prorated.description: The charge is prorated (recurring sum / unique_count only).

bypass.description: The period pre-pass found no event for this bucket.

per_event.description: Also return the per-event values used by per-event charge models.

exclude_event.description: per_event only: leave out the boundary event.

anyOf.description: The latest cached running state of the charge/bucket/group (written after each pay-in-advance event, or at invoicing for recurring weighted sums).

deduplicate.description: store ch only: the organization enables query-time de-duplication.

precise_total_amount_cents.description: dynamic charges: Σ of the selected events' amounts (BE-AG-27).

pay_in_advance_precise_total_amount_cent.description: dynamic charges priced in advance: the priced event's own amount, 0 when absent (BE-AG-27).

window.description: Charges window of the billing period (BE-AG-7): both bounds inclusive.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound (floored to the millisecond by the store).

charges_duration_days.description: Days of the full (unclipped) charges period; divisor of every proration and of weighted sums.
charges_duration_days.x-kit-absent: the number of calendar days from the date of `from` to the date of `to`, inclusive, in UTC

timezone.description: Customer's applicable time zone (local dates for proration).

transaction_id.x-kit-absent: "e<n>", n = the event's 1-based position in its list (give ids explicitly when a vector refers to them or when their text order matters)

timestamp.description: Event time (pg store keeps microseconds, ch store milliseconds).

properties.description: Event properties object as the ingestion API stored it (JSON numbers keep their JSON type).

properties_json.description: Alternative to `properties` when the literal text of the object matters (e.g. 1.0 vs 1).

ingest_seq.description: Ingestion order (later = larger); tie-break of equal timestamps where the reference has one.

enriched_value.description: store ch only: the `value` text the events-processor wrote for this event.
enriched_value.x-kit-absent: "1" for count; otherwise the events-processor's value text of the property (events-processor-spec EP-F1..F2). Every columnar vector whose result depends on the value states it explicitly.

precise_total_amount_cents.description: The event's own amount in minor units (chapter 02); read by dynamic charges only (BE-AG-27).

upgraded.description: Terminated by an upgrade (a next subscription on a pricier plan exists).

previous.description: A previous subscription with the same external_id (upgrade/downgrade chain).
